snippet.title: 마크툽(MAKTUB)-내가 죽으려고 생각한 것은 僕が死のうと思ったのは
snippet.description:

en-US.title: MAKTUB - What I Thought About Dying 僕が死のうと思ったのは
en-US.description:
May I never forget that I was originally the sea, even when swayed by small waves.

If I cried and the world laughed when I was born, I hope that on the day I depart, my life will be one where I laugh and the world cries.
